find a packing in unit-sized bins that minimizes the number of bins used.

was given by Karmarkar and Karp [163]. For further results, see the survey of Cofman, Garey, and Johnson [50]. The result cited in Exercise 9.7, showing that integer programming with a fixed number of variables is in P, is due to Lenstra [185]. Bin packing has also been extensively studied in the on-line model. For these and other on-line algorithms see Borodin and El-Yaniv [31].
